::: {.why}
Light day. Five sessions of one family each is easier than a mixed set, because in a real interview nobody tells you which technique applies.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Score a mixed set drawn from all five families without knowing which is which.
- Report whether your weakest category from day 330 has moved.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>50 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Finish anything outstanding from days 330 to 335, then run a mixed set: ten problems, thirty minutes, drawn from all five families in random order. The recognition step is what is being tested and it is the step the single-family sessions did not train.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [15 min]{.task-min} Update the error log and compare the category ranking against day 330. A category that has not moved after a week of work needs a different approach rather than more repetitions.
:::
:::

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Timed mixed set, ninth sitting: five problems in fifteen minutes, and this one is on top of today's thirty-minute set, so you are working tired. That is deliberate; the fourth interview of a superday is also tired.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Market making, fifth sitting: I quote you a market on a quantity with a known distribution, and you may trade any size up to a limit. How much do you trade, and how does size depend on your edge? The size answer is Kelly and you have already done that arithmetic on day 128.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Estimation: how many people are airborne over the United States right now? Reason to it, then say which of your assumptions the answer is most sensitive to.
:::
:::

::: {.deliverable}
A scored ten-problem mixed set and an updated error log with the category ranking compared against day 330.
:::

## Checkpoint

::: {.checkpoint}
Which of your five families is still slowest, and what is different about how you are practising it now?
:::
